glyph_policy.fallback: none; no font merging, family substitution, system fallback, or full-font copy
glyph_policy.missing_source_glyph: fail before replacing any output; list codepoint, Unicode name, and source locations
glyph_policy.name: current_source_and_original_cmap_union
glyph_policy.original_rule: Union of the four pinned recovered baseline cmaps is required in every output.
glyph_policy.runtime_contract: Runtime must use these subset FontFiles with allow_system_fallback=false and fallbacks=[]; dynamic non-ASCII content outside this corpus requires a new covered build or an explicit unsupported-text response.
glyph_policy.source_rule: Every literal source codepoint, including comments and syntax; decoded JSON strings and explicit Godot Unicode escapes are also included.
glyph_policy.style: Pinned Regular upstream outlines and metrics; preserve each original family naming table.
